interpretation: Host closed-loop engineering model only. No target timing or hardware effectiveness claim.

plant.frame: independent double abc RL/complementarity KCL plant
plant.current_root: 36-iteration double bisection, not the control predictor
plant.capacitors: separate upper/lower 440uF; dc resistor across P-N
plant.device: ideal diodes and gates, no drops or real sensor dynamics beyond a hypothetical 6.8us RC

sampling.ADC: four quantized held samples using original SOC order and channel skew
sampling.ESO: model reconstructed pole integral using two executed 10us gate segments, analytical rotating integral

THD.method: direct synchronous Fourier quadrature on every 2MHz physical-plant midpoint sample
THD.harmonics: 50Hz fundamental and 2..40 (100..2000Hz), exact last ten 50Hz periods
THD.decimation: none in harmonic integration; CSV has explicit 50kHz steady timestamps and earlier 5kHz trace
THD.bandwidth: 2MHz numerical sample grid; does not describe an actual instrument bandwidth

protection.status: proposal only; original4A exceedance reported separately; no hardware release
